profile.headline: Software Engineer
profile.summary: I am a software engineer dedicated to flipping ones and zeroes into impactful, real-world solutions.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Develop and maintain a high-performance, multithreaded C++ server on Windows for real-time monitoring of critical infrastructure, processing continuous high-frequency telemetry streams.
• Designed and implemented a cross-language service integration using gRPC and Protocol Buffers, building the client-side streaming pipeline in modern C++.
• Engineered high-throughput data paths with lock-minimizing techniques such as swap-and-drain batching, plus reconnect throttling and back pressure handling for fault tolerance.
• Debugged and resolved complex concurrency issues in multithreaded producer-consumer systems, including race conditions and queue state bugs.
• Built configuration-driven data mapping and loading components to integrate external data sources into the real-time processing pipeline.
positions.insights: Skills: C++ · Software Engineering · Power Systems

positions.title: Software Engineer II
positions.description:
• Contributed across the full SDLC—from evaluating design options to implementation, testing, root-cause analysis, and production rollout—for industrial automation software handling configuration, telemetry, alarms, and user management.
• Built and secured Rust (Actix Web) microservices with JWT / role-based access control, Argon2 password hashing, one-time reset tokens, structured logging, and metrics for observability.
• Evolved relational schemas and typed models (SQLite / SQL), added migrations, and tuned queries to improve correctness and latency on telemetry and alarm workflows.
• Integrated edge and plant-floor devices via industrial protocols (Modbus-TCP) and standardized data / tag models and alerting, enabling reliable, low-latency flows from devices to operator tools.
• Delivered operator-facing React / TypeScript features (configuration and alarm views, auth and reset flows, robust error / loading states, deep links), improving usability for engineering and operations teams.
• Automated CI / CD with GitHub Actions and Azure (ACR / App Services / AKS), implementing versioned artifacts, gated approvals, blue / green deployments, and health-check-based rollbacks.
• Resolved environment issues end-to-end (proxy / CORS with Vite + NGINX), stabilized build pipelines, and ensured consistent behavior across development, staging, and production environments.
• Co-authored theory-of-operation documentation, runbooks, and seeded end-to-end tests that shortened onboarding time, increased release confidence, and improved incident response.
• Worked in Agile teams to deliver small, reliable increments; simplified complex flows into clean, testable components aligned with high-reliability, performance-sensitive use cases.
positions.insights: Skills: C# · Software Engineering · React.js · Rust (Programming Language) · Full-Stack Development

positions.title: Senior Instructor II
positions.description:
• Execute advanced computer science lesson plans ranging from basic data structures to applied programming over Zoom for students ages 8-18 while adapting to student needs and interests.
• Communicate with family on a regular basis, providing updates on student progress and results from learning assessments.
• Maintain thorough records for each student, covering multiple courses and skill level progression.
positions.insights: Skills: Computer Science · Python (Programming Language) · Classroom Instruction

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Contributed to the development and maintenance of software systems for mission-critical applications, involved in all stages of the software development lifecycle with a focus on Agile and DevSecOps practices to support delivery in a fast-paced environment.
• Wrote clean and efficient code to interface with sensors, manage device connectivity, and handle data transmission.
• Developed an automation feature that reduced process time from six hours to less than five minutes using T4 templates for code generation.
• Maintained comprehensive documentation for the Azure IoT Embedded C SDK, including API references, usage guides, and troubleshooting tips; also contributed to the documentation for Azure Resource Graph APIs and query language best practices.
• Performed debugging and root cause analysis, diagnosing issues, implementing fixes, and conducting testing to ensure stability and prevent future problems.
positions.insights: Skills: Agile Methodologies · Engineering · Software Design · Software Infrastructure · C++ · C# · Embedded Software · Distributed Systems · System Architecture · C (Programming Language)

projects.title: Microsoft MsQuic – Open Source Networking Contributions (C/C++)
projects.description:
Diagnosed and contributed fixes to Microsoft’s open-source MsQuic QUIC networking library (C/C++), focusing on memory safety, ownership semantics, and lifecycle correctness for streams and connections.

Identified null-pointer dereference risks under out-of-memory scenarios caused by unchecked nothrow allocations and implemented safe validation using internal InitStatus and IsValid patterns aligned with existing RAII design.

Improved cleanup logic by enforcing correct handle ownership and Close() semantics for auto-delete resources, preventing double-free risks and invalid resource lifecycles.

Contributed pull requests after tracing control flow through listener, connection, and stream callbacks to validate correctness against msquic.hpp ownership model.

projects.title: Flow Log Parsing Project
projects.description:
This program reads AWS VPC flow logs and tags each log entry based on its destination port and protocol. It uses a lookup table to match (dstport, protocol) combinations to tags, then generates a summary report that includes:

The number of occurrences of each tag.
How often each port/protocol combination appears.
The number of flow logs that couldn't be matched to any tag (untagged).
The number of skipped or malformed flow log lines.
